Coati CR 1/3

This house-cat-sized creature bears its sharp canines with a chirping grunt trying to scare you away.

XP 135
N Tiny animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +2 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +4 (1d3-1), claws +0 (1d2-1)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 15, Con 11, Int 3, Wis 15, Cha 5
Base Attack +0; CMB +0; CMD 9 (13 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +7, Perception +6, Survival +2 (+6 when tracking by scent); Racial Modifiers +4 Survival when tracking by scent

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a coati familiar gains a +3 bonus on Survival checks.

ECOLOGY

Environment plains, mountains, and rain forests
Organization solitary or band (4 – 25)
Treasure none

A distant relative of the raccoon, the coati hunts during the day and uses its long snout for smell for their food. Gregarious and noisy, coati hunt and forage in groups. They use smell and their musk glands to help identify members of their band or others they have in their ‘family’.
